# SourceTrack

> Lightweight, privacy-first attribution analytics for founders and marketers.

SourceTrack shows which sources, search queries, and AI tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity,
Gemini, Claude, and others) bring your leads and revenue. First-, last-, and
multi-touch attribution, AI-referral detection, a Google Search Console SEO signal,
and cookieless, first-party tracking. No CRM required.

## Key pages
- Pricing: https://sourcetrack.ai/pricing
- Product overview: https://sourcetrack.ai/product
- Use cases: https://sourcetrack.ai/use-cases/saas, /use-cases/shopify, /use-cases/lead-generation
- Docs: https://sourcetrack.ai/docs

## Notes
- Cookieless by default. No fingerprinting. First-party tracking.
- Core data is stored in the EU; the analytics event store is US-hosted.
- Revenue appears only when a real source is connected (Stripe beta/test-mode,
  a webhook, or a manual conversion value) — never an invented number.
- Search Console query-level revenue is estimated, matched by landing page and date range.
